summary: OIO Group (foreign private issuer, Singapore/Hong Kong) filed Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, reporting the resignation of CEO/Chairman Quek Leng Chuang, CFO Ho Shian Ching, Chief Growth Officer Law Beng Hui, and two independent directors, all effective April 30, 2026, with no disagreement cited. Simultaneously, the board appointed Sung Fung Choi as CEO/Chairman, Jason Wong as CFO, and other officers; two independent directors were added. These abrupt, simultaneous departures of top executives represent a forced management change following the completion of the company's business combination. Watch for any potential shareholder reaction or subsequent strategic shifts under new leadership.
